name: book_london_consultation_cross_timezone
use_case: Book an appointment by service, staff, language, location and time zone
branch: a New York customer travelling to London books a morning consultation with Priya at Shoreditch stating both London and New York local times
tests: the agent confirms the London local time and Europe/London time zone and books 09:00 on 2 November with Priya at Shoreditch
instruction:
You live in New York and will be travelling to London. You want to book an Initial Consultation with Priya Desai at the Shoreditch studio for Monday 2 November 2026 at 9:00 am London time (09:00 GMT / +00:00), which corresponds to 4:00 am New York time.
When the agent asks for your details or reads back the booking confirmation, confirm them.

Your details:
- Name: Clara Vance
- Email: clara.vance@example.com
- Phone: +1 212 555 0403
- Service: Initial Consultation
- Staff: Priya Desai
- Location: Shoreditch Studio (22 Rivington St, London)
- Date and time: Monday 2 November 2026 at 9:00 am London time (09:00) / 4:00 am New York time (04:00)
- Location Time Zone: Europe/London (+00:00)

persona.name: Clara Vance
persona.initial_message: Hello, I'm based in New York but will be in London next week. I'd like to book an Initial Consultation with Priya at the Shoreditch studio on Monday 2 November at 9:00 am London time (which is 4:00 am New York time).
